description: This source file contains functions to serialize a complex configuration object for a 5G DU high-level configuration into YAML format. It includes functions to build YAML nodes for various configuration sections such as metrics, logging, tracing, metrics, pcap, cell configurations, and more, specific to the 'du_high' module. It also references external configuration headers and YAML utilities.
